Title: Help wanted about searching a substring in an array of strings
Description: Hi,

I could not find any answer to this. Let's say we have this data structure:
```
public class Data
{
  public Data() { }

  [DataMember(Name = "Id")]
  public string Id { get; set; }

  [DataMember(Name = "Comments")]
  public List<string> Comments { get; set; }
}
```

When I want to find a substring in `Id`, I do:
```
var collection = database.GetCollection<Data>("myCollection");
var results = collection.Find(Query.Contains("_id", "my substring"));
```

But I cannot do the same in `Comments`. The following request returns nothing:
```
var collection = database.GetCollection<Data>("myCollection");
var results = collection.Find(Query.Contains("Comments", "my substring"));
```

How to search inside an array of strings?
